authority: Department of Financial Services, Ministry of Finance (implemented through scheduled commercial banks, RRBs, and cooperative banks)

description.en: Kisan Credit Card provides farmers with timely and adequate credit for their agricultural operations including crop production, post-harvest expenses, maintenance of farm assets, and allied activities such as animal husbandry, fisheries, and sericulture.

verifiedConditions.appliesTo: All farmers including owner cultivators, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers
verifiedConditions.claim: All farmers including individual or joint borrowers who are owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, or sharecroppers are eligible for Kisan Credit Card.
Applicant must possess proof of land ownership or tenancy/lease agreement for the agricultural land for which credit is being sought.

unverifiedEligibility: Self-Help Groups (SHGs) and Joint Liability Groups (JLGs) of farmers are also eligible for KCC.
Fishermen, animal husbandry farmers, and sericulture farmers are eligible under the extended KCC scheme.
PM-KISAN beneficiaries are eligible for a simplified KCC process.

requirements.claim: Duly filled KCC application form available at the bank branch or downloadable from the bank's website.
Identity proof such as Aadhaar card, Voter ID, PAN card, or driving license is required for KYC verification.
Aadhaar number is mandatory for KCC issuance and for linking with PM-KISAN and other government schemes.
Land ownership documents such as land revenue records (khasra/khatauni), patta, or tenancy agreement/lease deed are required to establish the applicant's right to cultivate the land.
Two recent passport-size photographs of the applicant are required.
Details of crops to be cultivated, area under cultivation, and proposed cropping pattern are required for credit limit assessment.

processInformation.claim: Visit the nearest branch of a scheduled commercial bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or cooperative bank with the required documents. PM-KISAN beneficiaries can also apply through the PM-KISAN portal or Common Service Centres.
Submit the filled KCC application form along with identity proof, land documents, photographs, and crop details. The bank verifies the documents and conducts KYC.

The bank assesses the credit limit based on the scale of finance for crops, area under cultivation, post-harvest/maintenance expenses, and allied activities. For loans up to Rs. 1.60 lakhs, no collateral security is required.
Upon approval, a Kisan Credit Card with ATM/debit card functionality is issued along with a passbook. The credit limit is sanctioned for a period of 5 years with annual review.

processInformation.appliesTo: All KCC holders with crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakhs
processInformation.claim: Crop loans up to Rs. 3 lakhs attract an interest rate of 7% per annum with a further 3% interest subvention for prompt repayment, effectively reducing the rate to 4% per annum.

output.claim: A Kisan Credit Card with ATM/debit card functionality is issued along with a passbook. The card provides a revolving credit facility for a sanctioned period of 5 years with annual drawing limits based on cropping pattern and scale of finance.

fees.applicability: KCC loans up to Rs. 3 lakhs
fees.claim: No processing fee is charged for KCC loans up to Rs. 3 lakhs under the interest subvention scheme. For higher limits, banks may charge nominal processing fees as per their schedule.

fees.applicability: Crop insurance premium deducted at source
fees.claim: Crop insurance premium under Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY) may be deducted from the loan amount at the time of disbursement. The premium varies by crop and season.

processingTime.applicability: New KCC application under simplified scheme
processingTime.claim: Under the simplified KCC scheme, banks are mandated to issue KCC within 14 days of receipt of a complete application. PM-KISAN beneficiaries may receive expedited processing.

sources.title: RBI Master Direction on Kisan Credit Card Scheme
sources.evidenceExcerpt: RBI master directions prescribe the eligibility criteria, credit limit assessment methodology, interest rates, collateral requirements, and processing timelines for the Kisan Credit Card scheme.
claimsSupported: All farmers including owner cultivators, tenant farmers, and sharecroppers are eligible.
No processing fee for loans up to Rs. 3 lakhs.
Interest rate of 7% with 3% subvention for prompt repayment.
No collateral for loans up to Rs. 1.60 lakhs.
KCC is valid for 5 years with annual review.
sources.uncertainty: Individual bank-level processing timelines and documentation requirements may vary.

sources.title: NABARD — Kisan Credit Card Scheme
sources.publisher: National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development (NABARD)
sources.evidenceExcerpt: NABARD provides refinancing support and guidelines for KCC implementation. The scheme covers crop production, post-harvest expenses, farm asset maintenance, and allied activities.
claimsSupported: KCC covers crop production, post-harvest, and allied activities.
Credit limit assessment based on scale of finance and area under cultivation.
NABARD provides refinancing support to banks for KCC lending.
sources.uncertainty: Scale of finance varies by district and crop. Allied activity coverage may differ across banks.

sources.title: PM-KISAN Portal — KCC Linkage
sources.publisher: Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare, Government of India
sources.evidenceExcerpt: PM-KISAN beneficiaries can apply for KCC through a simplified process. The portal provides a facility for PM-KISAN beneficiaries to express interest in KCC, which is forwarded to banks for processing.
claimsSupported: PM-KISAN beneficiaries can apply for KCC online through the portal.
Simplified KCC process for PM-KISAN beneficiaries.
Aadhaar is mandatory for PM-KCC linkage.
sources.uncertainty: Bank-level response times for PM-KISAN KCC applications may vary.

limitations: This record covers the standard KCC scheme for crop production. Extended KCC for animal husbandry and fisheries is not fully modeled.
Individual bank policies, interest rate calculations, and additional documentation requirements may vary.
State-level variations in land revenue records and tenancy documentation are not covered.
The record does not cover KCC renewal, enhancement, or restructuring processes.
Crop insurance premium calculation methodology under PMFBY is not covered in this record.

review.reviewReason: Core KCC scheme information is reviewed, but extended coverage for allied activities and bank-specific implementation details need further verification.
